item.title: China’s giant sphere for hunting ghost particles has won a top engineering prize
item.description: A giant transparent ball – as tall as a 12-storey building and buried 700 metres (2,300 feet) under the rolling hills of southern China to catch ghostly particles – has won one of the world’s top engineering prizes. The Jiangmen Underground Neutrino Observatory, or Juno, took out the Supreme Award at a London ceremony on November 6 hosted by the Institution of Structural Engineers, the largest professional body in the field.
